description: Curated CoA compatibility and recommendation overlay for AzerothCore modules

rules.reason: Official companion bots for groups, dungeons and guild in Conquest of Azeroth.
Official dynamic dungeon and raid scaling system with solo modes.
SQUID's Playerbots with full autonomous AI. Mutually exclusive with CoA Companions.
Official Conquest of Azeroth modular core features.
NPC buff master offering spells, sickness removal, and player restoration. Verified dynamic DLL on CoA Plugin SDK.
Level-up celebration animations, fireworks and announcements. Verified dynamic DLL on CoA Plugin SDK.
Official NPC equipment enchanting module.
Periodic rewards and tokens granted based on active playtime. Verified dynamic DLL on CoA Plugin SDK.
Dynamically boosts player stats in group content. Verified DLL build; requires calibration with CoA Content Scaling.
Cross-faction battlegrounds system. Built into CoA core fork.
Resets health, mana, cooldowns and auras after duels. Verified dynamic DLL.
Classic PvP rank titles awarded based on honorable kills.
Automatically invites newly created characters into a designated starter guild.
Allows Death Knights to skip the Scarlet Enclave starter zone.
Directly conflicts with CoA classless progression & spell draft: automatically grants standard class spells, breaking player builds.
Direct gameplay authority collision with mod-coa-content-scaling: both systems attempt to dynamically scale creature health and damage.
Conflicts with CoA progression curve, dungeon level brackets, and content scaling gating.
Incompatible with CoA custom races DBC table (Esteria, etc.) and expanded race limits.
Upstream repository has missing script loader entrypoint (Addmod_ahbotScripts) causing compilation and linking failures. Use official mod-ah-bot-plus instead.
Requires external LuaJIT runtime and custom CoA spell system exports.
Redundant: CoA already provides a built-in wardrobe and transmog system configured in coa.conf.
